story.title: Joseph and his brothers
cards: Joseph's brothers sell him to traders going to Egypt
Joseph serves faithfully in Potiphar's house, and then is put in prison
Joseph interprets Pharaoh's dreams and is made ruler of Egypt
Joseph forgives his brothers and provides for his family in the famine
story.heart: Where did God turn a hard experience into good in your own life or in someone else's?
story.mission: Forgive someone this week, or thank someone who forgave you, and say why it matters.

story.title: Passover and the Red Sea
cards: The Israelites keep the Passover with the lamb's blood on the doorposts
Pharaoh lets the people go, and Moses leads them out of Egypt
The sea is divided, and Israel walks through on dry ground
The waters return and the Egyptians are overwhelmed
story.heart: When have you seen God make a way where there seemed to be no way?
story.mission: Tell a younger person the story of the Passover and what it teaches about God's deliverance.

story.title: Jonah and the great fish
cards: Jonah runs from God and boards a ship to Tarshish
A great storm comes, and Jonah is thrown into the sea
A great fish swallows Jonah, and he prays from its belly
Jonah preaches to Nineveh, and the city turns to God
story.heart: What does Jonah's story teach you about God's mercy for those you find hard to love?
story.mission: Pray this week for someone you have been unwilling to forgive or welcome.

story.title: Daniel in the lions' den
cards: Daniel is a trusted official, and his rivals plot against him
They trap Daniel by a law that he must pray only to the king
Daniel keeps praying to God, and he is thrown into the den
God shuts the lions' mouths, and Daniel is delivered in the morning
story.heart: What would it cost you to keep praying, even when it becomes difficult?
story.mission: Keep a daily time of prayer this week, and note one thing God answered.

echo.title: The Lord's Prayer

elements.label: Jesus taught his disciples to pray to Our Father in heaven
Hallowed be your name, your kingdom come, your will done
Give us today our daily bread
Forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors
Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil

echo.heart: Which line of the Lord's Prayer do you most need today?
echo.mission: Pray the Lord's Prayer slowly once a day this week, and pause on the line that speaks to you.

echo.title: The vine and the branches

elements.label: Jesus says he is the true vine
His Father is the husbandman who takes care of the vine
Every branch that bears fruit is pruned to bear more
A branch cannot bear fruit unless it abides in the vine
Without me you can do nothing

echo.heart: What helps you to stay connected to Jesus in busy weeks?
echo.mission: Spend time this week reading John 15 with a friend, and talk about what it means to bear fruit.

echo.title: Pentecost

elements.label: The disciples were all together in one place
A sound like a rushing wind filled the house
Tongues like fire sat upon each of them
They were filled with the Holy Ghost and spoke in other tongues
Some mocked, saying they were full of new wine

echo.heart: How would you describe the work of the Holy Spirit in your own life?
echo.mission: Pray this week for the boldness of the Holy Spirit to share your faith with one person.

echo.title: Bartimaeus receives his sight

elements.label: Blind Bartimaeus sat by the road outside Jericho
He heard that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by
He cried out, Son of David, have mercy on me
Many told him to be quiet, but he cried all the more
Jesus asked what he wanted, and he received his sight

echo.heart: What do you need to ask Jesus for, even if others tell you to be quiet?
echo.mission: Make a specific prayer request this week, and keep asking for it until God answers.
